subject: Application: Civil Engineer Draftsperson, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the Civil Engineer Draftsperson role at Brisbane Truss and Timber on SEEK (job 94985965), based in Bundamba.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge and field engineer.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and relocation discussion for the right role. I have not used Pryda software on a job; my drafting so far is from study in AutoCAD, Civil 3D and Revit.

Your Bundamba plant uses Pryda design software for roof trusses and wall frames for South East Queensland builders, and I want to learn that workflow under your estimators and engineers.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

paragraphs: I am applying for the Civil Engineer Draftsperson role advertised on SEEK for your Bundamba plant. I want to prepare civil, structural and timber construction drawings with your design team for South East Queensland builders.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at the Albright Institute of Business and Language: road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, with Australian Standards and Before You Dig Australia enquiries. In 2019 I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering in the Philippines.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed drawings, and carried out inspections and quality checks. As a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials and prepared site and progress reports.

I have not used Pryda or MiTech on a job; my CAD work so far is from study. I am based in Melton, Victoria, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation to Ipswich for this role.
My resume is attached and drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I would welcome the chance to learn your Pryda workflow and support your estimators and engineers.
